verdict.rationale: The pack never documents bulk operations such as multi-select editing, bulk tagging or bulk deletion. The closest evidence covers different capabilities: running evals over datasets, automatic online scoring and Topics classification of every trace, and exporting logs as CSV/JSON or via `bt sync pull`. These are batch evaluation, automated analysis and data export, not user-driven bulk actions, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
